name: ACE-Step-Studio
description: Portable AI music generator — full songs with vocals, covers, music videos. One-click install, 100% offline, NVIDIA GPU.

paragraphs: Suno at home: full songs with vocals from ACE-Step 1.5 on your own GPU. One executable — no Python, no Node.js, no launcher.

ACE-Step Studio is a desktop studio for ACE-Step 1.5, the open music model that writes and sings full songs. Describe a sound and write lyrics — or give it a one-line idea — and it plans the song with its language model and renders it with vocals on your own graphics card. Covers, remixes, repaints, a LoRA catalogue, your own LoRA trained on your songs, stems, MIDI, karaoke and video clips, all in one window. Windows installer with auto-update or a portable folder, runs offline on NVIDIA cards from 4 GB of VRAM.
It is built on acestep.cpp, the native C++/GGML port of ACE-Step 1.5. The studio around it is Rust and React in a Tauri window — nothing in the runtime path is Python.
